title: Reject duplicate tool registration
description:
Reject duplicate tool names in ToolRegistry.register instead of silently overwriting the earlier tool.

Problem:
ToolRegistry.register currently inserts tools into a Map keyed by tool.name. Duplicate names silently replace the previous registration, which can hide plugin/custom-tool mistakes and make runtime behavior order-dependent.

Acceptance criteria:
- ToolRegistry.register throws a deterministic, friendly error on duplicate tool.name.
- Add a focused unit test for duplicate registration.
- Existing default tool registration continues to pass.
- Error message includes the duplicate tool name.
close_reason: ToolRegistry.register now rejects duplicate tool names with a deterministic error including the name; added focused coverage and adjusted the one fixture that intentionally replaces roll.
